in_hebrew.name: Augustin
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Majestic, magnificent, venerable
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Augustin הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Augustin is derived from the Latin word Augustus, meaning majestic, magnificent, and venerable. The name was originally used to denote the Roman emperor and was later adopted by Saint Augustine of Hippo, a renowned Christian philosopher, and bishop.

in_greek.name: Augustin
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Majestic, magnificent, venerable
in_greek.long_meaning: Augustin είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. The name Augustin is derived from the Latin word Augustus, meaning majestic, magnificent, and venerable. The name was originally used to denote the Roman emperor and was later adopted by Saint Augustine of Hippo, a renowned Christian philosopher, and bishop.

in_latin.name: Augustinus
in_latin.meaning: nominis origo austerus, fortis, et sanctus
in_latin.long_meaning: Augustinus, nomen Latinum, a vocabulis Augustus et nomen gentilicium, significat virum austerum, fortem, et sanctum. Derivatur a vocabulis Augustus, quod significat magnus et fortis, et nomen gentilicium, quod significat origo. In Ecclesia Christiana, nomen Augustinus significat virum qui est austerus, fortis, et sanctus. Augustinus nomen erat nomen gentilicium, quod significat origo, et vocabulum Augustus, quod significat magnus et fortis. In Ecclesia Christiana, nomen Augustinus significat virum qui est austerus, fortis, et sanctus.
